label: Late original-phase position (t=4-7, last 4 tokens before <DEL>), strongest right after k/j
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.9% of mass), at absolute steps t=4..7 (t=5 holds 51% of mass, t=6 33%), and only when the step is one of the last ~4 original tokens (to_go<=3). It never fires at t<=3, at t>=8, or in the copy phase; the delimiter step gives only a trace. Inside this window it is sparse (~14% of window steps fire). Its strongest token driver is the previous input being k or j (lift 6-7x, together about 54% of mass; t, p, a are weaker, 2-3x). The largest activations are the step right after a k/j, typically at t=5-6, and often carry over to the next step. The predicate gets precision 0.72 and mass recall 0.51 on dev. The rest of the activation is weak, diffuse firing in the same position window with no clear token cue, so the description is incomplete. The position window alone reaches 97% recall at 14% precision. It does not depend much on the current input token, the number of digits, or whether the input is a repeat (it leans toward first occurrences).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=j (+5.05), prev_tok=k (+4.10), prev2_tok=k (+3.04), t=6 (+3.00), orig2=x (+2.75), orig1=x (+2.55). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-8.95), orig_idx=-1 (-7.82), prev_tok=x (-6.52), t=8 (-5.18).
